Asked for: thinking of renting out my flat in edinburgh on airbnb. which neighbourhoods charge the most per night, entire place vs private room, and how many reviews do guests leave each month?

This dashboard shows: Average Price by Neighbourhood, Average Price by Room Type, Overall Median Nightly Price, Monthly Average Review Count, Average Reviews per Month by Room Type, Average Reviews per Month by Neighbourhood, Total Reviews by Neighbourhood.

blocks.title: Overall Median Nightly Price
blocks.code:
import plotly.graph_objects as go

value = df['price'].median()
fig = go.Figure(go.Indicator(mode='number', value=float(value), number={'prefix': '$', 'valueformat': ',.2f'}, title={'text': 'Overall Median Nightly Price'}))
print(fig.to_json())

blocks.title: Monthly Average Review Count
blocks.code:
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px

data = df.copy()
data['date'] = pd.to_datetime(data['date'])
data['month'] = data['date'].dt.to_period('M').dt.to_timestamp()
monthly = data.groupby('month').size().reset_index(name='review_count')
monthly = monthly.sort_values('month')
fig = px.line(monthly, x='month', y='review_count', markers=True, title='Monthly Average Review Count', labels={'month': 'Month', 'review_count': 'Review Count'})
fig.update_layout(xaxis_title='Month', yaxis_title='Review Count')
print(fig.to_json())

import plotly.express as px

agg = df.groupby('neighbourhood', as_index=False)['price'].mean().sort_values('price', ascending=False).head(20)
fig = px.bar(agg, x='neighbourhood', y='price', title='Average Price by Neighbourhood')
fig.update_layout(xaxis_title='Neighbourhood', yaxis_title='Average Price', xaxis={'categoryorder': 'array', 'categoryarray': agg['neighbourhood'].tolist()})
print(fig.to_json())
